plausibility_notes: Justin is the strongest accusation because opened favor plus direct glass contact fits the laboratory transfer route.
No released independent record identifies contaminated favor or fragment-bearing paper as Justin's; others could open a favor and deny doing so.
Stage 8 supports a moderate-confidence accusation, not deductive exclusion of all alternatives.
Many final statements explicitly warn that documents are not alibis, which is fair but leaves limited affirmative proof.
